intro.title: A mining company rooted in the heart of Burkina Faso
text: GUEM'S MINING SARL is a single-member limited liability company incorporated under Burkinabe law, with its principal place of business in Ouagadougou, Nouveau Secteur 37.
According to its official documents, the company belongs to the mining sector, with “other extraction activities” as its main registered activity and mining operations as its secondary activity.

positioning.title: A player in Burkina Faso's mining sector
positioning.text: Mining plays an important role in Burkina Faso's economy. GUEM'S MINING SARL operates in this sector as a local company and aims to build lasting working relationships with its clients and partners, both nationally and internationally.

Its field of activity, as stated in its official documents, covers mining operations and extraction activities.

mission.text: To carry out our mining and extraction activities professionally and in compliance with applicable regulations, and to offer our clients and partners a serious and responsive point of contact.

items.text: Mining is the sector to which GUEM'S MINING SARL belongs. It covers all operations aimed at extracting mineral substances from a deposit, within the framework set by mining regulations.

legal.title: Legal notice and privacy
privacy: The data sent through the contact form (name, company, email address, phone, subject and message) is used solely to respond to your request. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

The website does not store messages in a database: they are forwarded by email to the company's business address and kept only for as long as needed to handle your request. To protect against abuse, a non-reversible fingerprint of the sender's IP address is temporarily kept on the server (one hour at most).

In accordance with the applicable Burkinabe regulations on personal data protection, you may request access to, correction or deletion of your data by contacting the company using the details on the Contact page.
The website does not use advertising cookies or audience measurement tools. Your language preference is stored locally in your browser. Fonts are loaded from the Google Fonts service.
